MQTT::disconnect
Description
This command disconnects the MQTT connection.
Syntax
MQTT
::
disconnect
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_DATA,
MQTT_SERVER_DATA
